<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant distributed cache client with namespace isolation.
 * Uses memcached text protocol over TCP.
 */

class TenantCacheConfig
{
    private string $tenantId;
    private string $prefix;
    private int $defaultTtl;

    public function __construct(string $tenantId, int $defaultTtl = 3600)
    {
        // Tenant IDs are validated at registration time - alphanumeric only
        $this->tenantId = $tenantId;
        $this->prefix = 'tenant_' . $tenantId;
        $this->defaultTtl = $defaultTtl;
    }

    public function getPrefix(): string
    {
        return $this->prefix;
    }

    public function getDefaultTtl(): int
    {
        return $this->defaultTtl;
    }

    public function getTenantId(): string
    {
        return $this->tenantId;
    }
}

class KeyEncoder
{
    /**
     * Encodes a cache key to be safe for the memcached protocol.
     * Memcached keys cannot contain spaces or control characters (0x00-0x1F)
     * and must be <= 250 bytes.
     */
    public static function encode(string $key): string
    {
        // Replace any bytes that are problematic for memcached keys
        $encoded = '';
        $len = strlen($key);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $ord = ord($key[$i]);
            if ($ord <= 0x20 || $ord === 0x7F) {
                // Percent-encode control chars and space
                $encoded .= '%' . strtoupper(dechex($ord));
            } else {
                $encoded .= $key[$i];
            }
        }
        // Truncate to 250 bytes max
        return substr($encoded, 0, 250);
    }
}

class CacheConnection
{
    private $socket;
    private string $host;
    private int $port;

    public function __construct(string $host = '127.0.0.1', int $port = 11211)
    {
        $this->host = $host;
        $this->port = $port;
    }

    public function connect(): void
    {
        $this->socket = fsockopen($this->host, $this->port, $errno, $errstr, 5);
        if (!$this->socket) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Cache connection failed: $errstr ($errno)");
        }
        stream_set_timeout($this->socket, 2);
    }

    public function sendCommand(string $command): string
    {
        fwrite($this->socket, $command . "\r\n");
        return $this->readResponse();
    }

    public function sendData(string $data): void
    {
        fwrite($this->socket, $data . "\r\n");
    }

    public function readResponse(): string
    {
        $response = '';
        while (($line = fgets($this->socket)) !== false) {
            $response .= $line;
            $trimmed = trim($line);
            if (in_array($trimmed, ['STORED', 'NOT_STORED', 'EXISTS', 'NOT_FOUND', 'DELETED', 'ERROR', 'END'])) {
                break;
            }
            if (str_starts_with($trimmed, 'SERVER_ERROR') || str_starts_with($trimmed, 'CLIENT_ERROR')) {
                break;
            }
        }
        return $response;
    }

    public function close(): void
    {
        if ($this->socket) {
            fclose($this->socket);
        }
    }
}

class DistributedCache
{
    private CacheConnection $connection;
    private TenantCacheConfig $config;

    public function __construct(CacheConnection $connection, TenantCacheConfig $config)
    {
        $this->connection = $connection;
        $this->config = $config;
    }

    /**
     * Build the full namespaced key for isolation.
     * Format: {prefix}:{user_key}
     */
    private function buildKey(string $userKey): string
    {
        $namespacedKey = $this->config->getPrefix() . ':' . $userKey;
        return KeyEncoder::encode($namespacedKey);
    }

    /**
     * Store a value in the cache with optional metadata tag.
     * The tag is stored as part of the flags field for categorization.
     */
    public function set(string $key, string $value, ?string $tag = null, ?int $ttl = null): bool
    {
        $encodedKey = $this->buildKey($key);
        $ttl = $ttl ?? $this->config->getDefaultTtl();
        $flags = $this->computeFlags($tag);
        $bytes = strlen($value);

        // Build memcached SET command: set <key> <flags> <exptime> <bytes>\r\n
        $command = sprintf('set %s %d %d %d', $encodedKey, $flags, $ttl, $bytes);
        $this->connection->sendCommand($command);
        $this->connection->sendData($value);
        $response = $this->connection->readResponse();

        return str_contains($response, 'STORED');
    }

    /**
     * Retrieve a value from the cache.
     */
    public function get(string $key): ?string
    {
        $encodedKey = $this->buildKey($key);
        $command = sprintf('get %s', $encodedKey);
        $response = $this->connection->sendCommand($command);

        if (str_contains($response, 'END') && !str_contains($response, 'VALUE')) {
            return null;
        }

        // Parse VALUE <key> <flags> <bytes>\r\n<data>\r\nEND\r\n
        $lines = explode("\r\n", $response);
        if (count($lines) >= 2) {
            return $lines[1];
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Delete a key from the cache.
     */
    public function delete(string $key): bool
    {
        $encodedKey = $this->buildKey($key);
        $command = sprintf('delete %s', $encodedKey);
        $response = $this->connection->sendCommand($command);
        return str_contains($response, 'DELETED');
    }

    /**
     * Flush all keys for this tenant using a tagged scan approach.
     * Sends a custom stats command to identify tenant keys.
     */
    public function flushTenant(): string
    {
        $prefix = KeyEncoder::encode($this->config->getPrefix());
        $command = 'stats cachedump 1 100';
        return $this->connection->sendCommand($command);
    }

    /**
     * Compute flags integer from an optional tag string.
     * Tags are hashed to a 16-bit value stored in the flags field.
     */
    private function computeFlags(?string $tag): int
    {
        if ($tag === null) {
            return 0;
        }
        // CRC16 of tag for categorization
        return crc32($tag) & 0xFFFF;
    }

    /**
     * Batch set operation with metadata annotation.
     * Annotation is appended to the protocol stream as a comment for debugging.
     */
    public function batchSet(array $items, ?string $annotation = null): array
    {
        $results = [];
        foreach ($items as $key => $value) {
            $results[$key] = $this->set($key, $value);
        }

        // Log annotation for distributed tracing
        if ($annotation !== null) {
            $this->logAnnotation($annotation);
        }

        return $results;
    }

    /**
     * Sends a version check with annotation for tracing.
     * The annotation is included in a noop/version command for log correlation.
     */
    private function logAnnotation(string $annotation): void
    {
        // Sanitize: remove all control characters that could inject protocol commands
        $clean = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/', '', $annotation);
        // Send as part of a version request for logging purposes
        $command = 'version ' . $clean;
        $this->connection->sendCommand($command);
    }
}
